trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    seps=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(v==6 for v in r)]
    if not seps: return out
    bounds=[-1]+seps+[h]
    frames=[(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(bounds,bounds[1:]) if b>a+1]
    color=None
    for k,(a,b) in enumerate(frames):
        cy=(b-a)//2; cx=w//2
        cells=[grid[y][x] for y in range(a,b) for x in range(w) if grid[y][x]!=0]
        if not cells: continue
        c=cells[0]
        if all(grid[a+y][x]==(c if abs(y-cy)+abs(x-cx)==k else 0) for y in range(b-a) for x in range(w)):
            color=c; break
    if color is None: return out
    for k,(a,b) in enumerate(frames):
        if any(grid[y][x] for y in range(a,b) for x in range(w)): continue
        cy=(b-a)//2; cx=w//2
        for y in range(b-a):
            for x in range(w):
                if abs(y-cy)+abs(x-cx)==k: out[a+y][x]=color
    return out
